{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"bs-01","text":"公司已形成多平台协同发展的业务格局，涵盖电视节目制作与销售、影视技术服务与设备租赁、媒体广告代理、影视拍摄基地经营以及基金投资与管理等多个领域。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"bs-02","text":"影视业务主要包括电视节目制作与销售、影视技术服务与设备租赁、影视库存剧销售等板块。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"bs-03","text":"广告业务主要承包经营总台科教频道及农业农村频道的整频道广告资源。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"bs-04","text":"旅游业务主要为无锡影视基地和南海影视城的影视拍摄基地经营。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"bs-05","text":"公司自2018年起布局基金投资业务，成立全资子公司宁波梅山保税港区国视融媒投资管理有限公司，专注融合媒体等特色细分行业的投资。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"ps-01","text":"电视节目制作与销售业务聚焦超高清/高清纪录片、电视栏目、大型晚会活动及宣传片等全链条服务，覆盖策划、投资、制作、运营与管理的全生命周期。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-02","text":"影视技术服务方面，公司为各类影视节目与剧目提供包括剪辑、包装、调色及设备、机房、演播室运维等全流程技术服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-03","text":"设备租赁方面，公司拥有完备的超高清及高清前后期制作设备，能够为超高清及高清电视剧、数字电影、纪录片、大型转播活动等多元影视制作提供全面的设备租赁与技术支持服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-04","text":"影视库存剧销售业务主要依托公司媒资资源，推动影视作品的多轮发行与销售，发行历年投资、制作及引进的电视剧、纪录片、电视栏目等作品。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-05","text":"旅游业务主要收入来源包括旅游门票销售、园内经营和影视拍摄服务等。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"ps-06","text":"南海影视城业务涉及影视拍摄、休闲旅游、研学教育、户外拓展、婚纱摄影、品牌展示等多元领域。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"ps-07","text":"国视融媒参与设立的中视融合（上海）企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙），配合推进央视融媒体产业投资基金；中视传媒及国视融媒共参与两只专项基金和两只融媒体产业基金的设立与募集。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"rm-01","text":"2025年公司实现营业收入1,037,484,312.21元，利润总额17,330,603.37元，归属于上市公司股东的净利润-17,956,761.63元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"1,037,484,312.21","value":"1037484312.21","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"利润总额","raw_value":"17,330,603.37","value":"17330603.37","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于上市公司股东的净利润","raw_value":"-17,956,761.63","value":"-17956761.63","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-02","text":"影视业务2025年实现收入597,703,872.09元，较上年同期增长2.56%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"影视业务营业收入","raw_value":"597,703,872.09","value":"597703872.09","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"2.56","value":"2.56","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-03","text":"广告业务2025年实现收入289,904,563.86元，较上年同期减少25.30%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"广告业务营业收入","raw_value":"289,904,563.86","value":"289904563.86","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"广告业务营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-25.30","value":"-25.30","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-04","text":"旅游业务2025年实现收入147,151,456.42元，较上年同期减少10.00%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"旅游业务营业收入","raw_value":"147,151,456.42","value":"147151456.42","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"旅游业务营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-10.00","value":"-10.00","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-05","text":"基金业务2025年实现收入1,503,221.93元，较上年同期减少3.69%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"基金业务营业收入","raw_value":"1,503,221.93","value":"1503221.93","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"基金业务营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-3.69","value":"-3.69","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-06","text":"主营业务分行业毛利率：影视业务10.04%，广告业务8.43%，旅游业务27.23%，基金业务100.00%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"影视业务毛利率","raw_value":"10.04","value":"10.04","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"广告业务毛利率","raw_value":"8.43","value":"8.43","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"旅游业务毛利率","raw_value":"27.23","value":"27.23","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"基金业务毛利率","raw_value":"100.00","value":"100.00","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"rm-07","text":"报告期内，公司参与投资的基金减持“海看股份”和“无线传媒”股票，公司因参与投资的基金减持股票产生大额所得税费用；同时，子公司中视广告前期大额未弥补亏损到期，转回递延所得税费用；受上述所得税费用因素影响，公司归属于上市公司股东的净利润出现亏损。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"sm-01","text":"2025年公司营业收入1,037,484,312.21元，较上年同期1,137,504,727.93元下降8.79%；营业成本911,538,539.48元，较上年同期下降7.68%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"1,037,484,312.21","value":"1037484312.21","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-8.79","value":"-8.79","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"},{"name":"营业成本","raw_value":"911,538,539.48","value":"911538539.48","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业成本同比增减","raw_value":"-7.68","value":"-7.68","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact","comparison_basis":"较上年同期"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-02","text":"主营业务分行业收入构成：影视业务597,703,872.09元，广告业务289,904,563.86元，旅游业务147,151,456.42元，基金业务1,503,221.93元。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"影视业务营业收入","raw_value":"597,703,872.09","value":"597703872.09","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"广告业务营业收入","raw_value":"289,904,563.86","value":"289904563.86","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"旅游业务营业收入","raw_value":"147,151,456.42","value":"147151456.42","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"基金业务营业收入","raw_value":"1,503,221.93","value":"1503221.93","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-03","text":"主营业务分行业营业成本：影视业务537,684,200.57元，广告业务265,471,667.70元，旅游业务107,080,345.66元；基金业务营业成本栏未列示金额。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"影视业务营业成本","raw_value":"537,684,200.57","value":"537684200.57","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"广告业务营业成本","raw_value":"265,471,667.70","value":"265471667.70","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"旅游业务营业成本","raw_value":"107,080,345.66","value":"107080345.66","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-04","text":"主营业务分地区收入：上海242,121,065.72元，无锡124,148,585.98元，北京642,811,084.51元，佛山25,679,156.16元，宁波1,503,221.93元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"上海地区营业收入","raw_value":"242,121,065.72","value":"242121065.72","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"无锡地区营业收入","raw_value":"124,148,585.98","value":"124148585.98","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"北京地区营业收入","raw_value":"642,811,084.51","value":"642811084.51","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"佛山地区营业收入","raw_value":"25,679,156.16","value":"25679156.16","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"宁波地区营业收入","raw_value":"1,503,221.93","value":"1503221.93","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"sm-05","text":"主要子公司经营规模：上海中视国际广告有限公司营业收入226,011,922.35元、营业利润3,841,740.44元、净利润-8,191,279.61元；北京中视北方影视制作有限公司营业收入437,781,183.83元、营业利润21,333,325.12元、净利润16,901,208.72元。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0013"],"metrics":[{"name":"上海中视国际广告有限公司营业收入","raw_value":"226,011,922.35","value":"226011922.35","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"上海中视国际广告有限公司营业利润","raw_value":"3,841,740.44","value":"3841740.44","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"上海中视国际广告有限公司净利润","raw_value":"-8,191,279.61","value":"-8191279.61","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"北京中视北方影视制作有限公司营业收入","raw_value":"437,781,183.83","value":"437781183.83","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"北京中视北方影视制作有限公司营业利润","raw_value":"21,333,325.12","value":"21333325.12","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"北京中视北方影视制作有限公司净利润","raw_value":"16,901,208.72","value":"16901208.72","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"oi-01","text":"公司作为总台准制作岛和技术服务的长期供应商，具备稳定的业务来源与良好的行业声誉；运维团队年均完成节目技审及通过专属节目传输通道在总台入库播出的节目约8,000小时。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"年均完成节目技审及入库播出节目时长","raw_value":"约8,000","value":"8000","unit":"小时","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"approximate"}]},{"fact_id":"oi-02","text":"无锡影视基地位于无锡太湖之滨，占地面积超1,000亩，主要由三国城、水浒城等景区组成。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"无锡影视基地占地面积","raw_value":"超1,000","value":"1000","unit":"亩","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"greater_than"}]},{"fact_id":"oi-03","text":"南海影视城位于广东省佛山市南海区，占地面积近1,500亩，涵盖天朝宫殿区、江南水乡区、港澳文化区和休闲游乐区。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"南海影视城占地面积","raw_value":"近1,500","value":"1500","unit":"亩","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","qualifier":"approximate"}]},{"fact_id":"oi-04","text":"影视业务成本构成中，职工薪酬250,999,754.59元（占本期总成本46.68%），技术服务费121,668,134.32元（22.63%），劳务费49,006,201.93元（9.11%），制作费47,272,703.17元（8.79%）。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"影视业务职工薪酬","raw_value":"250,999,754.59","value":"250999754.59","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务职工薪酬占本期总成本比例","raw_value":"46.68","value":"46.68","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务技术服务费","raw_value":"121,668,134.32","value":"121668134.32","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务技术服务费占本期总成本比例","raw_value":"22.63","value":"22.63","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务劳务费","raw_value":"49,006,201.93","value":"49006201.93","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务劳务费占本期总成本比例","raw_value":"9.11","value":"9.11","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务制作费","raw_value":"47,272,703.17","value":"47272703.17","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"影视业务制作费占本期总成本比例","raw_value":"8.79","value":"8.79","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"oi-05","tex
